theorems.name: Submission.bv_exists_contDiff_gradient_of_contDiff_two
theorems.statement: ∀ (n : ℕ) (w : Rn n → ℝ), ContDiff ℝ 2 w → ∃ G : Rn n → Rn n, ContDiff ℝ 1 G ∧ (∀ x v, inner ℝ (G x) v = fderiv ℝ w x v) ∧ ∀ x, ‖G x‖ = ‖fderiv ℝ w x‖
theorems.natural_summary: Implements the independently reviewed natural-language proof; see the theorem issue and retained proof.
